items.title: 1.7.5 Electron affinity ke periodic trends (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.7.5, printed page 12.

blocks.text: Jaise group mein neeche atomic jasamat barhti hai, bara electron cloud aane wale electron ko nucleus ki kam kashish mehsoos karata hai, to electron affinity aam taur par group mein neeche ghat'ti hai; halogens mein tarteeb At kam I kam Br kam F kam Cl hai. Period mein baen se daen electron affinities aam taur par zyada manfi hoti hain, pehle is liye ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur izafi electrons ko zyada mazbooti se kheenchta hai, aur doosre is liye ke atomic radius ghat'ta hai.

blocks.caption: Group 1 aur group 17 ki electron affinities, kJ fi mol (Table 1.1)

blocks.alt: Baen: periods 1 se 4 ke main-group anasir ka grid un ki Pauling electronegativity qeematon ke saath, potassium aur rubidium ke 0.8 se fluorine ke 4.0 tak, period mein aur group mein oopar barhne ke teeron ke saath. Daen: group 17 aur group 1 ki electron affinities do-column table ke taur par, nishan, doosri electron affinity aur rujhanon par notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Electronegativity ki qeematein aur groups 1 aur 17 ki electron affinities (Figure 1.8 aur Table 1.1 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Electron affinity period mein zyada manfi hoti hai, lithium ke -60 kJ fi mol se fluorine ke -328 tak, jaise nuclear charge barhta aur atom sukarta hai, aur group mein neeche kam manfi, chlorine ke -349 se astatine ke -270.1 tak, jaise atom barhta hai. Fluorine ki qeemat (-328) chlorine (-349) se kam manfi hai kyunke us ka bohat chhota 2p shell aane wale electron ko dhakelta hai. Baen ka electronegativity grid wohi simtein dikhata hai, alkali metals ke 1 se kam se fluorine ke 4.0 tak.

blocks.prompt: Fluorine chlorine se chhoti hai, phir bhi us ki electron affinity (-328 kJ fi mol) chlorine (-349) se kam manfi hai. Samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Chhoti jasamat aam taur par aane wale electron par zyada kheench ka matlab hai, magar fluorine ka 2p subshell itna tang hai ke pehle se maujood electrons naye ko zor se dhakelte hain, jo kashish ko kaat deta hai. Chlorine ke bare 3p subshell mein jagah hai, to woh zyada tawanai kharij karti hai.
